text:
incident-bot: ALERT: P1 incident detected - regen-queue latency spike (ID #487). Customers in us-west seeing 5-10s tail latency. Paging is active. Shift change in ~10m. Current drivers: jon (primary), akshay (comms). Please confirm handoff plan.

jon: I’m on the page. I'm fine to hand driver off for the sunrise shift but will stay as escalation for 30m. Maria can you take driver? I’ll drop a short runbook note.

maria: can take driver. Jumping on in 5. Akshay, want to keep comms or pass to Sam?

akshay: I can cover comms for the first 20m, then need to hand to sam for the daytime window. @sam?

sam: I can pick up comms after 20m. Will monitor status page and customer DMs.

jon: Plan: driver -> maria, comms -> akshay (then sam). Escalation contact stays jon for 30m. Noting customer impact: hosted API requests hitting regen backend occasionally time out, causing downstream retries. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.com/incident/487 (check error rate and 95p latency).

maria: Acknowledged. First steps from runbook: 1) check regen pod logs 2) scale processors 3) warm KV cache. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/regen-queue. Quick commands:
```
# tail logs
kubectl -n inference logs -f deploy/regen-processor --since=10m
# scale up replicas
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/regen-processor --replicas=4
```
I'll run the scale now and post results.

akshay: Doing comms post now. Drafting status note for #customers: "We're aware of increased latency to regen-backed features in us-west; engineers are investigating and mitigating. We'll update in 15m." Any additions? :speech_balloon:

maria: Posted initial status. Scaling to 4 replicas now...

incident-bot: Action: scale job queued by maria (user-maria). Watch for pod readiness events.

maria: Pods coming up, 2->4. Readiness probe shows one pod failing health check initially, restarting. Collecting logs: `ERROR: db connection timeout` - looks like occasional KV timeouts, possibly thrashing under load.

jon: If KV is the culprit, fallback in runbook: 1) enable degraded mode flag for regen service 2) disable heavy background batch jobs. Steps:
```
# enable degraded mode
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://api.internal/featureflags/regen/degraded -d '{"enabled":true}'
# pause batch job
kubectl -n infra scale cronjob heavy-batches --replicas=0
```
I'll be available to run these if we see more failures; Maria, try to keep comms posted every 5-10m.

akshay: Will update every 10m or on any material change. Notifying support-rotation and customer success.

maria: Degraded mode not enabled yet, pods mostly stable. Latency dropped to ~2-3s for affected routes. Continuing to monitor.

sam: Picking up comms in 18m per plan. I'll watch the incident channel and customer threads.

jon: Handoff complete: driver -> maria (primary), comms -> akshay -> sam (secondary comms). Escalation path: jon -> platform-lead. Leaving note in incident doc. If anyone needs me, ping here and page escalate. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: NOTE: Handoff recorded by jon. Shift owner: maria (driver). Comms owner: akshay (primary), sam (secondary). Escalation contact: jon.

maria: Thanks — taking lead. I'll post a 15m update or earlier if we change mitigation.

akshay: Acknowledged.

sam: Acknowledged.
